scheme_name: Abhayakiranam Scheme-Financial Assistance To Destitute Widows
other_conditions: Applicant should not be receiving a service pension or family pension.
Applicant should not be a beneficiary of schemes implemented through the Social Justice Department (Aswasakiranam, Samashwasam).
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for six months to the close relatives of destitute widows.
